purpose: Review city-local registry/cadastral basis and safe anonymous geometry-only routes.
registryBasis: Aracaju’s official SEMFAZ MapAju publishes fiscal lot polygons. Its public WFS layer `Limites_Municipais:malha_lote` is titled “Malha de Lotes Fiscais” and marked as a 2025 layer in SIRGAS 2000. Schema is geometry, objectid, lot inscription, block, and area; this is a municipal fiscal cadastre, not proof of title registration or citywide legal completeness.

searchQueries.query: Aracaju Brazil municipal cadastral lots map WFS official SEMFAZ parcels
searchQueries.scope: Find city-local land registry/cadastre source and an anonymous full-polygon geometry route.
searchQueries.result: The Aracaju municipal finance secretariat’s public MapAju viewer documents cadastral fiscal lots. The live WFS capability and schema documents expose a bounded full-polygon query with safe parcel/block identifiers and area. A three-feature anonymous query succeeded around the WUP locator; the locator itself is outside those three returned lots.

searchQueries.query: Aracaju mapa de lotes fiscais cadastro imobiliário municipal SEMFAZ WFS
searchQueries.scope: Find city-local land registry/cadastre source and an anonymous full-polygon geometry route.
searchQueries.result: O portal MapAju da Secretaria Municipal da Fazenda descreve a camada municipal de lotes fiscais. As capacidades e o esquema WFS ativos mostram geometria, inscrição do lote, quadra e área. Uma consulta anônima limitada retornou três polígonos completos; o ponto WUP não está dentro desses três polígonos.

accessReview.reason: Public WFS geometry is verified, but the layer is a fiscal lot cadastre (not a title register), uses a 2025 “in validation” source marker, and only a bounded sample was checked. Adapter/runtime qualification remains for the parent.
accessReview.nativeIdsUsed: Only the public fiscal-lot inscription, block code and provider feature/object IDs were retained for the bounded sample.

requestEvidence.observation: Live public WFS 2.0 capability document; 100 feature types. Target `Limites_Municipais:malha_lote`, title “Malha de Lotes Fiscais”, native CRS EPSG:31984, WGS84 bounding box spans Aracaju; layer keyword identifies 2025 in-validation fiscal lot mesh.
Schema exposes only geom (gml:MultiSurface), objectid, inscricao_lote, quadra, area. No person, owner, address, tax-value or account fields.

requestEvidence.method: GET bounded WFS GetFeature; count=3; field allowlist
requestEvidence.observation: Returned three complete MultiPolygon features and only the requested geometry/lot/block/area fields. The 100 m projected bbox is near the WUP point; none of the three returned polygons contains that point. Three unique full geometries retained.

technicalBlocker: Actual existing WFS adapter qualification failed three of thirteen local viewports and a fresh-ID batch: fiscal lot inscriptions 18010730067 and 18010570308 each identify multiple distinct native rows/geometries. Successful reads cover 365 valid distinct polygons without sampled overlaps, but these cannot establish a faithful complete parcel identity for the conflicting rows. No geometry was repaired, excluded or assigned a substitute canonical key. Native component semantics and a complete component contract remain unqualified; the 2025 in-validation notice is informational.
sampleDisposition: Retained three full municipal fiscal-lot polygons with a safe field allowlist.
remainingUncertainty: Legal status/vintage of the “in validation” 2025 lot mesh; full municipality coverage and paging/count behavior beyond the bounded sample; WUP point-to-parcel match.
